title: Sun's Galactic Orbit
body: The Sun orbits the center of the Milky Way galaxy once each $$2.60\times10**{8}\,\text{yr}$$, $$with$$ $$a$$ $$roughly$$ $$circular$$ $$orbit$$ $$averaging$$ $$a$$ $$radius$$ $$of$$ $$3.00\times10**{4}\,\text{ly}$$. $$Take$$ $$1$$ $$light-year$$ $$=$$ $$9.461\times10**{15}\,\text{m}$$ and $$1$$ year $$=$$ $$3.156\times10**{7}\,\text{s}$$.
